notes.title: OMUT - Social Media Roundup #1 - Gameplay, Giveaway & Pain
notes.notes:
It’s strange how things connect, isn’t it? Threads weaving themselves into a tapestry you didn’t ask for but can’t look away from. OMUT does that—[i]it does something to you[/i]. Have you felt it? Or have you avoided it?

If you’ve missed the latest from the OMUT vortex, let me guide you—though, let’s be honest, OMUT doesn’t ask; it pulls.

🎥 [b]OMUT - Gameplay w/ Commentary[/b]
Madame Cyclone dared to tread deeper. Watch a full gameplay stream with commentary and attempt to grasp what OMUT really is.
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iMU8EmjtZbM&feature=youtu.be]Watch here
[/url]

🌀 [b]Shorts from the Abyss[/b]
[i]It’s strange. [/i]Every time OMUT’s name is written, something shifts. Watch the trembling truth unfold.
[url=https://www.youtube.com/shorts/4IzxQPrSPTk?feature=share]View the Short[/url]

[i]Megabit hears things.[/i] Don’t we all? But these whispers? They’re not ours.
[url=https://youtube.com/shorts/Yq7o8O_mg48?feature=share]View the Short[/url]

[i]Let me tell you what lies ahead.[/i] (But don’t expect it to make sense. Sense is a luxury we no longer have.)
[url=https://youtube.com/shorts/q1g2gIxu-7o]View the Short[/url]

[i]Where are you?[/i] A question, or an accusation?
[url=https://youtube.com/shorts/qwuWPtQYpFg?feature=share]View the Short[/url]

I knew it would not be long. Time bends. Inevitability becomes your shadow.
[url=https://youtube.com/shorts/cHF4Tfaf334?feature=share]View the Short[/url]

[i]Pushnovsky[/i]. Listen carefully.
[url=https://youtube.com/shorts/tnrdKT0fS14?feature=share]View the Short[/url]


🎥[b]Devlog: Pixel Art[/b]

Even in creation, OMUT corrupts. The art shifts under its influence.
The art tells a story—or it tries to. But OMUT doesn’t let it speak clearly. In these interview clips, Madame Cyclone uncovers the unsettling truths behind the game's creation. What starts as pixel art becomes something... else. Watch carefully—what you see may not stay the same.
[url=https://youtube.com/shorts/NSaxhMPRCCA?feature=share]View the Short[/url]

[b]Devlog: Horrible Pain[/b]
[i]Horrible pain.[/i] Because OMUT doesn’t let you go unscathed. Creation isn’t without its cost. Every pixel, every line of code—it leaves a mark, and not just on the canvas. Madame Cyclone delves into the torment and obsession that fuels OMUT’s design. Horrible pain doesn’t just shape the game—it shapes us.
[url=https://youtube.com/shorts/qdue08pb-q0?feature=share]View the Short[/url]


💀[b]OMUT’s Champion Emerges[/b]
OMUT has awakened… and the spiral has claimed its first champion. 🌀 A massive congratulations to Hannah B. from NC, USA, for winning our PC giveaway! 🖥️
[url=https://x.com/OMUT_GAME/status/1864348752510652774]Read the news[/url]


You’ve caught up now, haven’t you? But something feels different—off. That’s how OMUT works. It’s always watching. Always waiting.

What do you hear, kiddo?

notes.title: I AM OMUT
notes.notes:
Fellow wanderers...

Alder Choke has evolved. The game’s grip on our minds is tightening while it pries open our eyes to show us its true nature. 

We have been developing for some time now and can only understand a thin slice of what we’re making. As we bring the abstract to reality, translating the visions into code and art and sound, we see more and more. 

Now the game has a new revelation for us. The name it wishes to be called. As it whispers the name into our ears, we have no choice but to obey. 

OMUT

[previewyoutube=BJeLQxJXbGo;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Meet ALDER CHOKE!
notes.notes:
[b]Alder Choke[/b], these are your players, you will torture them and never let them off easy. Players, this is [b]Alder Choke[/b], a story told through tears and deaths. Many deaths. Plural. Got it?

[previewyoutube=3bjNVzRtbDY;full][/previewyoutube]

In other words, allow us to introduce a new game from Fulqrum Publishing's portfolio, developed by the talented devs from [b]Madame Cyclone[/b]! In this boss-rush action shooter you will face completely different enemies that will find unique ways to make your day a living hell. But once you learn how each boss works, you will become THEIR living hell! Eventually. Maybe. Not gonna lie, that won't happen anytime soon. But you will keep coming back for more anyway.

There is already a playable demo available, but what do you have to look forward to in the full version? Well...

[list]
[*] 20 unique bosses, each in their own, different arena
[*] system of upgrades, purchased with currency gained in boss-fights
[*] narrative dialogue scenes
[*] new special abilities to use on your journey
[/list]

As we said, [b]Alder Choke[/b] has a free demo available right here on Steam. We strongly recommend you play it, even for a few minutes. It's one of the most addictive games we've ever put our hands on!

And as always, please share all your impressions and feedback here in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1997330/discussions/]Steam discussions [/url]or come join our [url=https://discord.gg/fulqrum-publishing]Discord[/url]!
